product_metadata.title: Wilton Gingerbread Boy Comfort Grip Cookie Cutter
features: Heavy Duty, Rust Resistant, Stainless Steel Gingerbread Boy Cutter
Gingerbread Man is Approximately 5" Tall x 1" Thick
description: These stainless steel cutters with extra-deep sides are perfect for br ownies biscuits sandwiches sheet cakes cheese and more. The cushio n grip gives you comfortable control even when cutting into very thick desserts. Recipe included.

Thicker and heavier than traditional tin models, this stainless-steel cookie cutter also goes through the dishwasher without rusting like tin. And a rubber cushion on the top protects hands. The cutter stamps out a 5-inch gingerbread boy cookie, ready to be brought to life with icing or to be dressed by sprinkles. Unlike shallow cutters, this one is 1 inch high, so it can be used for all kinds of thick doughs and even for cutting a cake. Use it also for crafts.
